explainer_content.short_definition: Fast melodic punk streamlined for hooks, youth culture, and skate-era radio.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Pop-punk turned punk's short songs and speed into bright, repeatable, emotionally direct guitar pop for the 1990s and 2000s.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It became one of the main ways punk vocabulary entered mainstream teen memory.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The sound is faster and simpler than power-pop revival, but more polished and chorus-first than first-wave punk.
